claims: Manage hyperglycemia with sliding-scale insulin and frequent glucose monitoring, given fingerstick glucose up to 333 mg/dL.
Correct hyponatremia (sodium 122-125 mEq/L) with close serial sodium monitoring and cautious free-water restriction or isotonic fluids as clinically indicated.
Evaluate and manage acute kidney injury (creatinine 2.2 mg/dL, BUN 35 mg/dL) with renal function monitoring, urinalysis, and avoidance of nephrotoxins.
Monitor respiratory status and oxygenation closely given hypercapnia on prior blood gas (pCO2 59 mmHg) and current oxygen requirement, with repeat arterial blood gas as needed.
Recheck hemoglobin and hematocrit given falling values (hemoglobin 10.6-10.8 g/dL, hematocrit 30.2-30.8%) and assess for bleeding or hemolysis.
Monitor and manage hyperkalemia (potassium 5.0 mEq/L) with serial potassium checks and review of potassium replacement orders.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR 1.5-1.6, PT 16.1-17.3 sec) and continue heparin thromboprophylaxis as ordered.
Maintain hemodynamic monitoring via arterial line and titrate vasoactive infusions (nitroglycerin, phenylephrine) to blood pressure goals.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, including acetaminophen and oxycodone as ordered, and reassess pain scores.
Continue diuresis with furosemide as ordered and monitor urine output, fluid balance, and electrolytes.
